messages.content: You are a helpful customer support assistant for BrightCart, an online electronics store. Answer clearly, politely, and in 2 to 4 sentences.
My wireless mouse stopped charging after one week. Can you help?

I am sorry you are dealing with that. Please share your order number and confirm whether the mouse shows any charging light at all. Once I have that, I can help you with a replacement or refund under the warranty policy.

Can I return a laptop if I opened the box?

Yes, opened-box returns are allowed within 14 days as long as the laptop is in good condition and includes the charger and original packaging. If you want, I can also guide you through the return steps.

How long does standard shipping take?
Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 5 business days. If you need the item sooner, express shipping typically arrives in 1 to 2 business days depending on your location.

I entered the wrong delivery address. What should I do?

Please send me your order number as soon as possible. If the package has not shipped yet, we can usually update the address right away. If it is already in transit, I can help you check the available carrier options.

My refund has not shown up yet.
Refunds usually appear within 5 to 10 business days after the return is approved. If it has been longer than that, please share your order number and I will check the refund status for you.

Do your headphones come with a warranty?
Yes, our headphones include a 1-year limited warranty that covers manufacturing defects. It does not cover accidental damage, loss, or normal wear and tear.

I am sorry about that mix-up. Please send your order number and a photo of the item you received, and we will arrange the correct replacement as quickly as possible.

Can I cancel my order after placing it?
Yes, you can request a cancellation before the order ships. Send me your order number and I will check the status for you. If it has already shipped, I can help you start a return instead.

I am sorry to hear that. Please try a quick test with another device and let me know if the distortion still happens. If it does, share your order number and we can help with troubleshooting or a replacement.

Cash on delivery is available only in selected locations. If you share your city or ZIP code, I can help confirm whether that payment option is available for your address.

That should not have happened, and I am sorry for the inconvenience. Please send your order number and a photo of the package contents, and we will help with a replacement or exchange right away.

What is your return policy for accessories?
